notes.title: [Update 1.01] Lag and Freeze Issues Fixed
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've just released update 1.01 to address performance issues some players experienced.

Patch Notes:
[olist]
[*] Fixed lagging issues during gameplay.
[*] Resolved freezing problems affecting certain users.
[/olist]
Thank you for your continued support!

tags.bug: [*] Resolved freezing problems affecting certain users.
